title: The End of the Day – Reborn

pkg.confirmedTitle: The End of the Day – Reborn
pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
At the end of the day, Reborn
Let's go!!
[Verse 1]
The starlight dances quietly outside my window
The breeze that passed through the alley gently speaks to me
“It's okay, you did well today”
All the pieces of this day slowly fall into place
[Pre-Chorus]
The hazy moonlight flows softly across my window frame
Filling every corner of my room with gentle light
My tired shoulders slowly catch their breath
Even my little sigh feels warm tonight
[Chorus]
At the end of the day, the evening starts to dream~
Only now, I finally smile a little~
All the countless moments gently hold me in their arms~
And fill me up in this quiet evening~
[Verse 2]
A long shadow stretches across my desk
Steam still lingers above the cup of tea gone cold
The traces of today I've written in my notebook
Glow softly underneath the moonlight
A bicycle bell rings somewhere beyond my window
It feels like someone's journey home is walking beside me
[Pre-Chorus]
The hazy moonlight wraps around my room
Whispering softly, almost like I'm talking to myself
“It's okay now, everything will be alright”
My quiet heart finally begins to smile
[Chorus]
At the end of the day, the evening starts to dream~
Only now, I finally smile a little~
All the countless moments gently hold me in their arms~
And fill me up in this quiet evening~
[Bridge]
Even as time keeps passing, it's okay for me to stay right here…
Even if I slow my steps, even if my heart walks slowly, that's enough…
I hope this warmth will never fade away
I wish this quiet moment could last forever
[Final Chorus]
At the end of the day, I dream again
Only now, I finally smile out loud
Every moment holds me in an overwhelming embrace
And fills me forever in this quiet evening
[Outro]
The starlight is still dancing outside my window~
Quiet happiness is blooming throughout my little room~
Thank you… for staying here beside me…
“You worked so hard today~”
“Sleep well, for another tomorrow~”
“…You can do it!!”
"Fighting!!"
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
